ensure selection of appropriate materials to comply with drawing and specifications

modules.module_title: Mark and measure various timber and timber-based materials

pcs.pc_description: check all tools and machines are in good working order and available/are on site
ensure proper selection of appropriate timber and timber-based materials
identify different components of the products as per the given specifications
prepare a cutting list of various components of the product based on materials and design specifications
perform the measurement and marking on timber and timber-based materials based on layout plan and cutting list
use geometric methods to determine complex angles, joints, and intersections from product drawings

modules.module_title: Perform woodworking operations on different components of the product

pcs.pc_description: select and safely use hand and power tools to cut and shape various components of the product
perform cutting of the wood/panels as per cutting list
ensure that the cut components are in line with the design specifications
prepare the wood/panels into the required shape as per the specified measurements
prepare jigs or fixtures of required specifications to shape the various components of the product
ensure that all the measurements of the components meet specifications
perform cutting of laminate/veneer sheet to specified specifications and paste using adhesives on the surface of product components
mark and drill the required holes and grooves for product assembly

modules.module_title: Fabricate internal and external joints for product assembly

pcs.pc_description: check and confirm the joint geometry conforms with the product drawing
undertake the preparation of accurate joints and intersections with no gaps
use appropriate hand tools and machines for joint preparation, e.g., traditional tenon saws, Japanese pull saws, band saw, powered hand router, and miter saw
prepare joints that are parallel, clean, and correct in size to the drawing
ensure faces, edges, and all shoulders are square straight and to the drawing
ensure proper checking of joints for strength and durability

modules.module_title: Assemble the various components of the product

pcs.pc_description: interpret the assembly drawings and use the appropriate method for assembly
measure the dimensions of various components of the product and perform marking operations to facilitate the assembly of components
ensure that the product components are assembled as per instruction using appropriate fasteners or/ add adhesives as applicable
ensure that the structures are assembled and erected accurately without damage to components
check the assembled components functioning as per the control plan, work instructions
ensure quality checks at regular intervals during assembly to avoid any defects/ error detection at a later stage

modules.module_title: Finish the surface of the product

pcs.pc_description: identify and select the appropriate wood fillers to finish the product to a specified standard
use appropriate tools to smoothen the surface (curves, edges, molds, etc.) of the product through sanding by machine and/or by hand to a specified standard
maintain the quality of the surface during assembly and installation, e.g., free from glue and any defects or chips

modules.module_title: Install the product along with hardware fittings

pcs.pc_description: check the location of the installation to prepare requisite cut-outs for electrical outlets, plumbing points, wiring, and other arrangements in the assembled product
identify and select the appropriate tools and equipment for installation of components/parts and sub-assemblies of the product
install the moldings/ finish accessories (crown molding, decorative panels, etc.) in accordance with the manual/instructions provided
install the furniture fittings (like locks, latch, closure, handles, etc.) in the finished product
ensure quality checks at regular intervals during installation to avoid any defects/ error detection at a later stage
supervise the cleaning of the installed product thoroughly before handover

modules.module_title: Perform quality check of the product before handover

pcs.pc_description: conduct post- completion quality check of the furniture and fitting in line with the organization practice
check and ensure that the final finish of the product is as per client requirement and design specification
inspect and mark the defects, if any, such as in paint, dents, grooves, cracks, rough edges, etc. on the physical body of the product
take appropriate action for fault rectification in consultation with supervisors
take note of inputs/ feedback received by supervisor /client to incorporate at the work
maintain all the requisite documents post completion of project in compliance with organization policies

modules.module_title: Prepare the resources for wooden doors and windows assemblage

pcs.pc_description: identify and select the timber based on design specifications of the given door/ window
maintain the moisture content of the timber within specified limits
plan and organize required materials, tools, and equipment for door/window fabrication and installation
check that the selected tools and equipment are in safe working condition and ready for use
verify dimensions and type of the opening are as per the size of the frame
perform the required woodworking operation on the materials as per design specifications
measure the dimensions of the door/window panel to ensure the correct size of the frame
prepare the material pieces into the required shape as per the specified measurements
check visually for any surface damage on the components before assembly and installation processes
ensure that the work area is free of clutters to carry out installation work smoothly

modules.module_title: Install flashings for door and window frames

pcs.pc_description: identify suitable flashing materials to be used with frame installation
plan out the installation of flashing with suitable overlapping of sides to avoid water spillage
mark the measurement on the flashing for frame installation and trim the extra pieces
make use of the bottom to top approach while installing flashings
ensure proper pasting of flashing using small flat block, tapping, and running down on the frame
apply sealants at the exposed edges and corners once the flashings get installed on the frame

modules.module_title: Perform assembly and installation of wooden doors, windows, and frames

pcs.pc_description: ensure correct methods of holding and centering the work piece
ensure the use of appropriate lifting devices for lifting doors/ windows
grout the gap between the wall and the door frame, if required, perform chipping and chiseling of the masonry structure
ensure proper alignment of the door frame against the setting out the lines
install the door/window frame and sub- frame as per specification
install the door/window panels as per the given design specifications
ensure a consistent gap between door/window panel and door/window frame
ensure the miter joints are flat and square at corners for a seamless finish

modules.module_title: Install architectural hardware, fittings, and accessories

pcs.pc_description: interpret the product drawing and identify the type of hardware and accessories required for the doors and windows installation
identify and use required tools and equipment for installation of hardware and accessories
measure and mark the dimensions on the product to determine hardware positioning
make provisions for the installation of fittings by preparing slots and cut-outs
install hardware and accessories in accordance with the job and manufacturer specifications
ensure the proper functioning of the hardware after installation and make necessary adjustments as required

maintain the moisture content of the timber within specified limits
plan and organize required materials, tools, and equipment for cladding/ panelling fabrication and installation
check that the selected tools and equipment are in safe working condition and ready for use
interpret the quantity of the panels required for the room based on design specifications
ensure proper measurement of every length, opening, bulge, and recess of the room/area
identify the types of adhesives to be used based on the condition of the wall and area of installation
perform the required woodworking operation on the materials as per design specifications
prepare the material pieces into the required shape as per the specified measurements
check visually for any surface damage on the components before assembly and installation

modules.module_title: Perform assembly and installation of cladding/ panelling

pcs.pc_description: measure and mark the dimension of the panels on the wall to determine the installation position
ensure proper joinery of panels to avoid gaps and loose pieces while accommodating the natural seasonal movement of the timber
make provision for drained and ventilated cavity open at the top and bottom to prevent moisture into the panels
ensure correct methods of holding and centering the workpiece
check the vertical and horizontal alignment of panels using appropriate tools
undertake requisite cut-outs for electrical outlets, plumbing points, and other arrangements
